title: The Baguette Band
subtitle: A single unbroken line of baguettes, cool and architectural on the hand.

stone.carats: Custom — ring size, grade, and carat weight fully configurable
stone.origin: Natural. Channel-set in a seamless line.

metal: 18K white gold, 18K yellow gold, or platinum
description: An eternity band composed entirely of baguette-cut diamonds, channel-set edge to edge in one seamless line that encircles the finger without a break. The baguette is the most architectural of cuts — flat planes, clean corners, light returned in long cool sheets rather than sparkle — and set this way the band reads as a single ribbon of ice around the hand. Made to exact specification in white gold, yellow gold, or platinum, in our Los Angeles atelier.
